name: function
provenance: genericized from taxonomy_v0 functional labels; cues only; no AppWorld runtime

labels.name: Retrieve
labels.definition: Read, show, list, download, or inspect existing information.

labels.name: Search
labels.definition: Find resources matching a query or filter.

labels.name: Create
labels.definition: Create, add, upload, write, or initiate a resource.

labels.name: Delete
labels.definition: Delete, remove, or detach a resource.

labels.name: Communicate
labels.definition: Send, post, reply, forward, or otherwise communicate.

labels.name: Authenticate / authorize
labels.definition: Establish, verify, reset, or end identity access.

labels.name: Respond / react
labels.definition: Approve, accept, review, like, subscribe, or reject.

labels.name: Execute / control
labels.definition: Run a task or control playback, alarms, queues, or system behavior.
